description: Hourly Electricity Demand and Weather Data for Major U.S. Cities (2019\u20132023) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Mohammed Sleiman, Rui Bo. "This dataset provides a curated, multi-regional hourly electricity demand and weather resource for 141 U.S. metropolitan areas spanning five years (2019\u20132023), constructed to directly support AI and machine learning model development in power and energy systems. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
